biotools.summary: TockyLocus is an R package that standardizes quantitative analysis of flow cytometric fluorescent timer data, particularly focusing on Timer Angle data and categorizing cells into five biologically relevant loci. It provides methods for analysis, visualization, and statistical testing of transcriptional dynamics.
